title: WordCraft
description: A minecraft mod where Spelling and Creation of minecraft can come together as one.
body: On This mod, Spelling and the power of Creation can come together as one. you can use the letters from blocks, entites, and or alphabet mobs that I coded into the game. Letters from blocks is a chance drop containing on how to spell that block. And Entites will also drop their letters containing on how to spell out that specific entitie.
